claims.claim: Raw/pre-clamp native instrumentation avoids treating rounded Plan Rows as semantic error.
Census and DMV are complementary sparse/large-universe and dense/IN-heavy regimes.
Mechanism-aware object counts are first-order maintenance proxies with environment-specific coefficients.
CE-Replay matches native PostgreSQL inside the supported fragment across controlled tests and fresh deployments.
The ScalarArray extension expands canonical DMV coverage from 52 to 1965 queries without breaking scalar regressions.
Statistics-set inclusion is empirically non-monotone on both workloads.
Semantic necessity and recurring-resource necessity are independent motivations for selection.
Changing Census from byte proxy to maintenance resource materially changes design composition and loss.
DMV local search leaves capacity unused rather than accepting non-improving statistics.
Empty-design singleton utility does not determine contextual contribution.
Global optimality is established only on small/restricted audits; workload-scale results are neighborhood local optima.
Sparse degree can coexist with a giant component, so local invalidation does not require global decomposition.
Incremental MCV evaluation preserves the full audited trajectory while reducing control replay and runtime.
Mixed semantic evaluation preserves trajectory and reduces control work but is slower wall-clock than the algebraic oracle.
Dense DMV still permits meaningful replay-work avoidance, without proving a runtime speedup.
Exact invalidation needs structural/counterfactual dependency rather than current-output equality alone.
MCV consumption suppresses downstream FD use, and composition-aware selection restores useful FD consumption in both workloads.
Both final selected states were physically realized and fresh replay matched fresh native PostgreSQL.
Repeated Census ANALYZE demonstrates payload variability while same-realization replay remains faithful.
DMV lacks a paired frozen-to-fresh per-query drift distribution because frozen numerical provenance was not persisted.
DMV provenance incompleteness does not invalidate fresh physical composition or same-fresh-realization semantic fidelity.
The two zero-truth DMV queries dominate raw aggregate q-error, so raw cross-workload loss is not compared and nonzero loss is diagnostic only.
